title: The Service Sticker Sits a Little Crooked
premise: In a parked close-up, a windshield service sticker sits a few degrees off level. We hold the frame long enough to establish that it is still crooked.

title: Finding Maintenance in the Owner's Manual
premise: We search the owner's manual index for the heading 'Maintenance' and land on a page number. The video stops before the page earns its close-up.

title: Counting Letters in a Dashboard Reminder
premise: A parked dashboard shows a short service reminder while the camera counts its characters twice. The count agrees both times, and the reminder remains unexplored.

title: One Faded Label on the Spare Alternator
premise: The spare alternator's box has a faded parts label, so the camera zooms in and loses focus. We put the box back without discovering what the last line says.

title: The Vehicle Notes Log Starts With a Blank Page
premise: A traveler opens a small vehicle log to its first blank page and writes the heading 'Vehicle Notes.' The camera gives the heading an unusually long establishing shot.

title: The Dashboard Reminder Hides Behind a Steering Wheel
premise: From the passenger seat of a parked SUV, the camera tries two ordinary angles to show a dashboard service reminder. The steering wheel blocks the same corner of the message both times.

title: The Manual's Maintenance Chart Has Two Columns
premise: A traveler finds the maintenance chart in the parked SUV's owner's manual and points out its two columns, months and miles. The SUV is behind on both, for different reasons.

title: Turning Spare-Part Codes Into Names We Can Say
premise: A traveler reads the part numbers printed on the spare alternator, transmission part, and tire, then writes a plain name next to each in the vehicle log. Nobody learns how to install anything, but now they can yell the right word.

title: Two Different Sources for the Same Maintenance Reminder
premise: The windshield service sticker says one thing about the next oil change, and the dashboard says another. The traveler films both, explains where each came from, and declines to pick a side.

title: A Car With a Service Schedule Gets an Unscheduled Life
premise: The windshield sticker says the SUV is due for service at a mileage it will pass somewhere in a flood zone. At each stop a traveler writes the current odometer under it, and the column of numbers becomes a diary of an oil change that keeps not happening.
